headline: Olam Agri Secures Delta Land for Animal Feed Plant to Ease Supply Gap
summary: Olam Agri has secured 99.99 hectares of land in Ogwashi-Uku, Delta State, to establish an animal feed plant aimed at reducing the local supply gap.
why: Agribusiness investments in production facilities help local supply chains, reduce import dependencies, and expand agricultural processing capabilities.

impacts.name: Olam Agri
impacts.why: Securing land for a new feed plant expands the company's operational footprint in the region.
